class.name: SfxAutomation
class.brief_description: Clips of an [SfxEvent] that follow a parameter instead of the clock.
class.description: Clips placed on [member parameter_name]'s axis: a clip plays while the value is within [member SfxClip.offset] .. [member SfxClip.offset] + [member SfxClip.length], overlapping ones crossfade by their fade curves. The value is the instance's, else the player's, else [member min_domain].

members.member: Its clips. Assign a new array to change it.
Chooses the clip by the value when the instance starts and never again - a one-shot's chunk (wheel clatter by speed, a click by step). The instance then ends with that clip.
Start of the axis (and the value without one).
Keeps looping clips in step: a clip starting mid-way starts at the shared phase of the event's clock.
The shared loop period of [member phase_locked].
Pitch over the whole axis, on top of each clip's.
